entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac. I'm calling about an order I placed a while ago. I bought a cycling jersey and I need to return it.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
It's a preference, I suppose. It's the wrong size for me. I finally got around to trying it on for a ride and it's just way too tight. I was hoping to exchange it for one size up.
I see. Sizing issues can be tricky. Let me just pull up your account. Could I get your name and the order number?
Of course. The name is Alex Chen, and the order number is VF-8675309.
Thank you, Alex. One moment... Okay, I see the order here. It looks like it was delivered 56 days ago.
Yes, that sounds about right. I know it's been a bit. Is it still possible to do an exchange?
Absolutely. Our policy for standard items like this jersey allows for returns and exchanges within 90 days of delivery, so you're well within the timeframe. I can process this for you right now.
You're welcome. I've just initiated the exchange for the next size up. I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email address on file. Just print it out, attach it to the package, and drop it off.

Perfect. Now, since I do have to go through the trouble of repackaging this and taking it to the post office, would you be able to offer a small discount code for a future purchase? Just for the inconvenience.

I'm happy we could get that exchange set up for you. While I can't provide a discount code for this type of situation, I have expedited the processing on our end. As soon as the carrier scans your return, your new jersey will be shipped out.
Okay, I understand. It was worth asking. I appreciate you getting the exchange approved so easily.
Of course. Is there anything else I can help you with today, Alex?
No, that's everything. Thank you, Isaac.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
